verdict.rationale: AnythingLLM lets users decide where data lives. It runs entirely on the user's own computer with no data leaving the device, and it can be self-hosted via Docker on the user's own infrastructure. Community comments add that users can pick their own vector stores and that external components are opt-in, so residency is whatever location the user deploys to. Missing for 10: region selection for the vendor-hosted option, explicit data-residency documentation, and independent hands-on corroboration of residency control.
